title: Google Philippines to train over 1 million teachers on AI
key_facts: Google Philippines aims to upskill over 1 million public school teachers in AI, with the Department of Education (DepEd)
Country manager Prep Palacios announced it in a speech on Tuesday (13 Oct 2026)
A 2025 Digital Education Council survey found 86% of teachers want to use technology but only 17% are confident trained
ASEAN Foundation data: 83% of Filipino students have used generative AI for study versus 73% of teachers for teaching
Training is via the Google AI Educator Series, 15 to 45 minute self-paced online modules with digital badges
It is live on DepEd's Bureau of Learning Delivery Hub and will be endorsed nationwide by a Joint Circular
Google is working with the National Educators Academy of the Philippines on accreditation for licence-renewal credit units
Also open to teachers at CHED and TESDA
quote_evidence: Google Philippines said it aims to upskill over a million public school teachers nationwide in artificial intelligence.
Teachers can earn digital badges after completing the 15- to 45-minute self-paced courses.
why_it_matters_hint: A big tech company is becoming a major provider of AI training for public school teachers in the Philippines.
notes: Read in full. Company aim, not a completed result.
